ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant high-intensity white central field and low-intensity black borders along the trailing edge and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region spanning the majority of the fluke's surface; low-intensity black pigmentation is localized to a narrow band (approx. 5-15 pixels wide) along the trailing edge and a central triangular patch at the peduncle insertion.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a 2D projected angle of approximately 55 degrees and a well-defined vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels along the entire trailing edge, isolated from the turbulent water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Complex curve featuring a convex sweep along the trailing edge leading to tapered lateral tips, with the left lobe exhibiting slightly higher terminal elevation than the right in this perspective.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (mottling) scattered near the center-left ventral surface and the base of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular recession on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, potentially representing localized physical trauma or significant wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct dark 'Y' or 'V' shaped pigmentation pattern at the point where the fluke meets the peduncle.
